diagnosis: Vendor DRI reads legacy EGL display layout, selects X11 instead of Wayland, then treats dri2_egl_surface as an XCB loader object.

static_evidence.screen_creation: mtgpu+0x6e52f0 stores loaderPrivate at screen+0x18, reads platform+0x30/native+0x38. Platform 2 maps to internal kind 4 at 0x6e5ed7.
static_evidence.drawable_creation: mtgpu+0x6ea114 selects generic image branch for kind4; kind0 plus no DRI2Loader takes XCB branch at0x6ea2f0. It locks surface+0x100 then passes surface+0 to xcb_get_window_attributes at0x6ea402.
static_evidence.image_branch: mtgpu+0x89d450 stores opaque surface loaderPrivate at object+0x20 without dereferencing its layout during creation.
static_evidence.secondary_screen: musa+0xe510 stores loaderPrivate at screen+0x18, init+0xbbe0 forwards it via+0xaf60 to support+0x238f0, which retains it at support screen+0x10.
static_evidence.secondary_fd_callback: support+0x281f40 resolves to musa+0xa950. It checks IMAGE_LOADER version>4 and nonnull tail+0x38. Version2 returns -1 without reading the legacy display DriverData.
static_evidence.image_lookup_callback: support+0x1582c loads the retained screen loaderPrivate as third parameter, calls callback at+0x281f28 (musa+0xa910), which forwards to screen IMAGE_LOOKUP.lookupEGLImage.

patch.scope: Reviewed x86-64 mtgpu 3.1.0 Wayland display only
patch.lifetime: embedded in dri2_egl_display through destroyScreen, then freed with display private data
patch.marker: MTT compatibility: Wayland display ABI bridge

limits: Static review and one captured failed core do not establish complete opaque binary behavior.
Corrected screen/drawable path has not been exercised on S30 hardware.
Actual library branch replay, callback regression, software client smoke test and next recovery-gated hardware run remain acceptance requirements.
